# ataila_service_account (Data Source)

One service account, by `id` or by `name`: its owner, roles, how many tokens are live, and the GitLab projects linked to it. Never a token. Needs a token holding `service-accounts-read-global` (or the admin key) and platform release 1.0.397 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service account made in the portal, read by name.
data "ataila_service_account" "deployer" {
  name = "ci-deployer"
}

output "deployer_live_tokens" {
  value = data.ataila_service_account.deployer.active_tokens
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The account's user id (a UUID), assigned by the platform: `principal.id` in `ataila_whoami` for its tokens. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) The account's name. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `active_tokens` (Number) How many of its tokens are live now (never a token itself).
- `ci_links` (Attributes List) The GitLab projects whose pipelines may exchange their ID token for a one-hour token of this account (`ci_jwt`), by issuer and path. Read-only: an operator links and unlinks a project in the portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ci_links))
- `created_at` (String) When the account was created: RFC 3339 in UTC, compared as an instant.
- `email` (String) The account's synthetic e-mail address, which receives no mail.
- `is_active` (Boolean) False when the account is deactivated.
- `owner_customer_id` (String) Id of the customer this automation identity belongs to; omit it (or set null) for the platform operator's own.
- `owner_customer_name` (String) The owner customer's short name; null without an owner.
- `roles` (Set of String) The permission keys the account holds.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed: RFC 3339 in UTC, compared as an instant.

<a id="nestedatt--ci_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ci_links`

Read-Only:

- `allow_destroy` (Boolean) Exchanged tokens may archive, delete, deactivate and retire.
- `id` (String) The link's id.
- `issuer` (String) The GitLab whose ID tokens the link accepts (its address).
- `live_tokens` (Number) Tokens exchanged through this link that still work.
- `project_path` (String) The GitLab project, as its ID tokens name it (`group/project`).
- `protected_refs_only` (Boolean) Only pipelines of protected branches and tags may exchange.
- `scopes` (List of String) The scopes every exchanged token gets, less any the account no longer holds.
